pack.proposed_change: Proposal: Add predicted-versus-realized expected-value calibration to the validated-state gate. Hypothesis: a subset of states currently passing the validated-state gate realizes materially less net EV than predicted (validation overfit or regime drift), so the gate should abstain whenever a state's trailing realized-minus-predicted net EV breaches its historical bootstrap confidence band. Falsifiable test: using already-logged DEMO outcomes in bot/intel/outcome_log.jsonl, bin sealed trades by p
pack.risks: unvalidated idea; tiny DEMO risk only

concerns: Falsifiable test specification is incomplete/truncated; not currently actionable as registered experiment
Mechanism claim mismatches design: abstention reduces throughput by construction
No minimum sealed-sample threshold per state bin; sparse DEMO bins yield either dead-wide or noisy-narrow bootstrap bands

Lookahead/circularity risk unaddressed: predicted EV must derive from strictly pre-trade information, and realized-minus-predicted calibration must not reuse the same OOS folds already used for promotion gating
Multiple-comparison inflation across many state bins (false drift triggers); needs FDR control or shrinkage
Affected paths include bot/intel/ which contains governed artifacts (intelligent_champion.json): proposal must guarantee no new writer path outside the designated promote scripts
bot/ai_council/ modification scope is undefined; council-code changes warrant separate review
Breach behavior unspecified: abstention duration, re-entry/reset criteria, hysteresis against flip-flopping
Interaction with existing remaining-EV and tail-loss controls not specified
votes.reason: The core idea is sound and safety-conservative: predicted-versus-realized net EV calibration with bootstrap-band abstention is a legitimate drift/overfit monitor, it only adds an abstention condition (never removes a gate), and it is DEMO-only using already-logged outcomes. However, the proposal is materially incomplete: the falsifiable test is truncated mid-specification ('bin sealed trades by p...'), baseline evidence is None (PF=None, EV=None), the stated mechanism ('improve exploration/validation throughput') contradicts the design (an abstention gate reduces trade count; it can improve net-EV selectivity, not throughput), and no sample-size, lookahead-control, breach-policy, or governed-write-path details are provided.
requested_revisions: Complete the test spec: exact state bins, trailing window lengths, per-bin minimum sealed-trade counts, bootstrap method and confidence level
Restate expected mechanism honestly as reduced negative-EV exposure / improved net-EV selectivity with accepted lower trade count
Default to pass-through (no abstention) when a bin is under-powered; gate activates only above the sample threshold
Add explicit lookahead controls: predictions timestamped pre-entry, realized outcomes post-close, both net of runner spread/slippage assumptions, calibration data disjoint from promotion OOS folds
State file-level guarantees: zero writes to intelligent_champion.json and other governed intel artifacts; list ai_council edits separately
Define breach policy: abstention window, reset condition, and interplay with existing EV/tail-loss gates
Run phase 0 as measurement-only (log calibration deltas, no gate enforcement) to quantify the effect before enforcement, pre-registered in ExperimentRegistry with numeric falsification thresholds

concerns: No minimum sealed-trade count, recency window, or multiple-testing control is specified.
The predicted EV definition and cost/slippage alignment with realized EV are unspecified.
Historical bootstrap bands may leak information or fail under nonstationary regimes.
Abstention may reduce exploration/validation throughput, contrary to the stated expected mechanism.
No bounded rollback trigger or monitoring metrics are defined.
votes.reason: The proposal is safety-compatible for DEMO research, but its calibration method, sample sufficiency, leakage controls, and exact abstention behavior are underspecified. A bootstrap confidence band alone can be unstable across sparse state bins and regime changes.
requested_revisions: Define state identity, prediction timestamp, net realized-EV calculation, and identical cost assumptions.
Require sealed, time-ordered outcomes; compute bands using only outcomes available before each decision.
Specify minimum sample sizes, recency weighting/window, confidence level, hysteresis, and treatment of sparse states.
Run a shadow-mode OOS comparison against the current gate, reporting coverage, abstentions, predicted-versus-realized calibration, and net costed expectancy.
Add explicit monitoring and rollback thresholds; record the experiment in ExperimentRegistry and prevent any champion promotion unless governed promotion gates pass.

votes.reason: The hypothesis is plausible, but the proposal is incomplete and lacks sufficient statistical and operational detail to approve even a DEMO test. The falsifiable test, state definition, calibration method, confidence-band construction, sample-size threshold, and rollback behavior are underspecified.
